title: Part Sixteen: Why the Belief Survives

sections.brief: Polls on the Dream (PRRI 2012 53%/2014 42%; WSJ/NORC 2023 36%, 2025 31%; AP-NORC Apr 2026 34%; Gallup 'get ahead by working hard' 76-77% (2001-02) to 52% (2026), R 85/D 24; Pew personal achieved/on way/out of reach 30/37/31 (2022) and 31/36/30 (2024), income 64 vs 39); perceptions vs data (Alesina-Stantcheva-Teso 11.7 vs 7.8; Kraus & Tan and Kraus replication; Davidai & Gilovich; Chambers et al. underestimation as dissent); just-world (Benabou-Tirole), system justification (Jost 2003) vs Brandt 2013; Mijs 2019; Sandel; survivorship (BLS establishment survival 79.6/50.6/34.7%); where the belief is right; labelled interpretation with counter-readings. Figures: stats; compare (told vs record); flow

Bootstraps etymology (1834 mockery, 1922 OED sense); Reagan 1980 and Trump 2015 'make America great again'; Bush 2004 'ownership society'; Boehner 2011 'job creators'; Clinton 1996 welfare signing; Obama 2012 'you didn't build that' in context, 2014 'ladders'; DREAM Act 216-198 / 55-41 (Dec 2010), DACA status as of April 2026; enacted records Carter to Trump in one register (401(k), PATCO, TANF 68 to 21 per 100 vs AEI employment gains, 1998/2005 bankruptcy changes, homeownership 69.4 to 63.1, minimum wage frozen since 2009, ACA uninsured, Biden-era rules vacated, TCJA/OBBBA estate and CBO distribution); where words and laws agreed. Figures: time; compare (told vs record)

Case & Deaton PNAS 2015 (45-54 white non-Hispanic, +0.5%/yr after 1998, 96,000 / 488,500, education gradient, other countries); 2020 book (600,000; employment 84 vs 68%; wages -13%); critics Ruhm 2018 (<1/10 economic) and Henderson (PCE +4.5%); overdose record 25,785 (2003) to 107,941 (2022 peak) and provisional 81,313 (2024), 69,973 (2025) as counter-evidence; suicide 48,824 (2024); Chetty JAMA 2016 income-longevity gap 14.6/10.1 years, widening, geography and correlates; Gallup satisfaction by income; life expectancy 79.0 (2024).
